monitor_finding: M4_halves reads WARN on the first real window: earlier half +0.4669 on 17 trades, recent half -0.0798 on 18. The threshold was declared before shadow.py existed and it fired on the first data it saw. NOTHING was changed in response — a threshold adjusted because it fired is a description of the past, not a monitor.

revoke_policy.auto_revoke_considered_and_refused: A monitor that can silently null the research flag is a monitor that can be gamed by a quiet period, and withdrawing a research claim belongs to the human who made it.
revoke_policy.asymmetry: Registering requires passing a pre-declared gate; revoking requires only a human saying so. It is easy to stop claiming something and hard to start.

wiring.interface: signal_for(symbol) — the same one TradingBot already calls
wiring.why: A parallel shadow universe drifts from the shell that would eventually trade it. Plugging into the existing interface means every gate, the kill switch, the risk chain and the protective-stop guarantee apply unchanged; the caps are ON TOP.
wiring.defect_found_by_the_replay: The first version proposed on EVERY flagged bar rather than at run starts, taking 55 trades on the OOS window with a NEGATIVE mean where the cleared rule scored +0.1736. The pilot would have monitored a rule that loses money while reporting healthy status. Fixed causally: propose only when the previous decision bar was not a setup. See EDGE.md 41i.

shadow_replay.note: A wiring proof. No rotation null, no control, no percentile. It cannot register anything: the hook reads only *_summary.json artefacts that pass the slice-57 OOS gate, and this is not one.

closer_note: NO. Live is blocked, no model exists, nothing is armed and this slice adds no path toward any of them. What it adds is apparatus for watching a thin clear decay.
